rationale: The stock gapped down ~20% on a significant earnings miss and is now trading in the upper portion of today's range (68%), having bounced from the $23.83 low toward $25.28 — but the 1-minute tape shows momentum stalling with a bearish candle (high of $25.44, close at $25.32) after a push higher, suggesting the bounce is losing steam. The fundamental catalyst is clearly negative (earnings miss, sell rating), yet the stock has already recovered substantially from the open gap, making a short entry risky near intraday resistance ($25.95 high) and a long entry unattractive given the overhead supply and negative news overhang. The risk/reward in either direction is unclear at this mid-range location.
